switch_measurement: Signed native ids at every CDAC switch, oriented using its physical reference electrode. For each side and bit, sum channels within each polarity then take max(0,min(I_refp_to_plate,I_plate_to_refn)). Sum the sixteen bank overlaps. Peak and trapezoidal charge cover -50 ps to +2.5 ns per command at 4 ps. Duration uses a reporting threshold of 1 uA. The corrected analysis uses the original TT waveform and checks ids direction against sampled physical drain and source voltages.
settling_measurement: Weighted absolute error of the selected MOM plates relative to the active instantaneous reference rails. Replay times are recorded from independent ADC runs. Actual decision edges are scored in the paired ADC simulations.
driver_control: Cell-LPE XREF plus same-geometry standalone CDAC PEX. Coupled pair includes driver transistors and routing PEX. The comparison measures their combined effect.
fixed_top_load_method: Sum of extracted TOP capacitance to ground, VDD, VSS, VREFP and VREFN. The project uses 57 fF per side and 1 fF differential as screening proxies. The independently measured CDAC weights used for the code check come from the utility-filled standalone acceptance extraction.

analysis_history.reason: The initial detector assumed that the model vds preserved external terminal orientation. Reversed source/drain fingers exposed the error. The replacement uses signed ids and physical drain/source orientation on the saved waveform.

open: No signed-off shoot-through current or charge budget.
Final-fill CDAC gain and TOP fixed-load/imbalance screens in the assembled XREF–CDAC.
